name: Double Extension Executable Execution
description: Detects execution of a binary disguised with deceptive double extensions (e.g. invoice.pdf.exe).
explanation: A classic spearphishing tactic where malicious executables use legitimate document icons and double extensions to trick users into running them.
investigation_steps: Quarantine or capture the executable for static analysis.
Determine origin location (e.g., Downloads folder, browser cache, email client attachment cache).
Check FIM and persistence logs for unauthorized modifications.
